First space system fully designed, built, and operated by the company.
Description

SOAP and PANDORE will showcase U-Space's proficiency in nanosatellites construction. SOAP represents an important milestone for U-Space by being the first space system fully designed, built, and operated by the company.
Results

+5 months in orbit for SOAP and PANDORE… And everything is going according to plan! Since their launch, our two satellites have successfully completed each stage:

  • Stabilized orbit
  • In-flight software updates
  • Initial mission tests
  • First payload data acquired
